name: Patricia Fronek Memorial Bursary
summary: Up to $1,000 for Griffith social work students in financial hardship.
key: Maximum value is $1,000, payable in a single instalment.
who: Griffith Bachelor of Social Work, Bachelor of Social Work (Honours) or Master of Social Work student.
Demonstrate financial hardship based on a comprehensive assessment by the University.
how: Apply through Griffith's online scholarship application process.
catches: Apply by Monday 19 April 2027, 4pm, for Trimester 1 2027.
Not available if you received other Griffith scholarships or financial support in the past 12 months.
